title: Cross-Tool Agent Config Evaluation
goal: Decide whether ECC should be used as a direct personal base or as an upstream component library with a thin overlay that works across Claude Code and Codex.
prompt: Using only these sources, evaluate whether Everything Claude Code should be used as a direct personal base or as an upstream component library with a thin customization overlay for a setup that must work across Claude Code and Codex. Answer in four sections: 1) key evidence from official Anthropic docs, 2) what ECC is strong at, 3) risks of deletion-heavy forking, 4) recommended architecture and update workflow. Be concrete about settings, hooks, subagents, context overhead, and project-level vs global customization.

sources.label: Trail of Bits Claude Code config
